posts.cooked:
We had six people at Arsenal tonight – four forum regulars and a couple walk-ins who were very enthusiastic.

We’re considering doing this regularly and the consensus was for a Wed, once a month.

I have something that’s scheduled every other Wed, so simply picking the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, or 4th Wed of the month is problematic for me, as sometimes that would put me in conflict.

For those interested, would it work for you if we started on Wed July 25th and then met every four Weds, such that it would be a bit more often than once a month? The first few dates would be July 25, Aug 22, Sep 19, Oct 10.

Timing would start at 6pm and go as late as people are interested and the store is open (10pm).

Personally I’d prefer something a bit more frequent than once every four weeks, but I can understand how busy you might be. I’d be in for what you’d suggest, and then maybe if a subset wanted to meet prior to the next official meetup, so be it.
